verification.tls: Normal certificate verification enabled; per-request SSL context with supplied environment proxy CA. No verify=False, authentication, paywall or access-control bypass.

normalization.status: Compare roster bucket, not athlete injury labels; Day-To-Day is not roster status. Official PS/Injured remains explicit.
